mapper.select: SELECT t.device_code AS deviceCode, t.device_name AS deviceName, t.manufacturer_code AS manufacturerCode, model.model_name AS deviceModelCode, t.location AS location, t.longitude AS longitude, t.latitude AS latitude, n.device_code AS uavNestCode, n.device_name AS uavNestName, nestM.model_name AS deviceModel, n.manufacturer_code as modelCode, n.longitude AS uaLongitude, n.latitude AS uaLatitude FROM vm_uav_device_info_t t LEFT JOIN vm_uav_nest_device_info n ON n.device_code = t.uav_nest_code LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_model_t model ON t.model_code = model.model_code and model.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN vm_uav_nest_device_model_t nestM ON n.model_code = nestM.model_code and nestM.delete_flag = 0 WHERE t.device_code = #{deviceCode}

SELECT rel.device_name FROM vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel WHERE rel.delete_flag = '0' AND rel.device_type = 1 AND rel.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rel.device_code = #{deviceCode} AND rel.industry_code = #{tradeId} LIMIT 1
